description: Poll a notify token from an intent receipt for door-state changes at a brand's Outpost. Returns your registration (ticket, intent, received-at), the Outpost's current door-state version and summary, whether the door-state has changed since your registration, and the live demand snapshot. In v1 door-states are census-static, so "changed" is false until a re-census bumps the version. Free, no API key.

token.description: The notify token from your intent receipt's poll URL

name: poll_notify
